records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased by $10.9 million, or 8.7%, during the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2023, primarily due to the sale of our Lubbock operations, rationalized volume at plants undergoing turnarounds, a customer settlement received in 2023 and unfavorable foreign exchange effects of $1.1 million.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general, and administrative expense decreased by $1.4 million during the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2023, primarily due to lower incentive compensation expense.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Interest expense decreased by $0.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2023, primarily due to a reduction in the Term Loan balance due to the partial pay down of the outstanding balance with proceeds from the sale of our Lubbock operations.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Cost of sales decreased by $7.4 million, or 7.1%, during the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2023, primarily due to the decrease in sales.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Other operating income, net changed favorably by $0.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2023, primarily due the loss on sales of machinery and equipment recognized in 2023.
